title: Volkswagen Golf 4 Usb Dashboard Jack
author: user_317880369
description:
This piece allows you to use a female usb connector on your Volkswagen Golf 4 dashboard. You will need a female usb cable to your car radio.

VW Volkswagen golf dashboard USB jack usb female

meta.profile_notes: No support needed You can play with different build plates for a different front finish.

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
